fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-05 (afternoon, 16:40): The complainant noticed that Rs. 1,20,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The complaint mentions Hariharan Babu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000154, in connection with the events. Murugan Sundaram (9000000207) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100018. Potentially relevant material referenced includes transaction records and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, transaction record, afternoon, receiving account, witness, mobile number, digital document
